notablePrerequisites: Ghave does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Ghave persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ghave, adding {C}{C}.
When Ghave dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its ability.
Repeat.
